meta.name: Inuyasha
meta.description:
Kagome Higurashi, an average ninth grader, gets pulled into an ancient well by a demon, bringing her 500 years in the past to a feudal era.

Shows: Inuyasha Movie 1: Affections Touching Across Time (English Dubbed), Inuyasha Movie 3: Swords of an Honorable Ruler (English Dubbed), Inuyasha Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island (English Dubbed)
Available on: Pluto TV
